definition.name: Shaver outlet · isolated 230 V side
definition.description: A two-pin shaver outlet with a small shaver load connected. The transformer inside the supply unit is shown separately on the workbench.

terminals.label: SEC 1
terminals.purpose: This is one end of the isolated shaver load. Measure across the two secondary contacts to read the outlet voltage.

terminals.label: SEC 2
terminals.purpose: This is one end of the isolated shaver load. Measure across the two secondary contacts to read the outlet voltage.

parts.name: Housing
parts.purpose: The case holds the working parts in place and keeps them apart.

parts.name: Removable cover
parts.purpose: Lift the cover on the bench to see the connections underneath.

parts.name: Terminal clamps
parts.purpose: A clamp holds the bare end of a wire against the metal terminal.

parts.name: Mounting and fixings
parts.purpose: These keep the fitting in place. Look for the screws or clips that hold it.

parts.name: Plug and socket contacts
parts.purpose: The plug pins meet these contacts when the plug goes in. Each has its own job.

definition.abstraction: The lesson uses the 230 V pair. The second plug position and its interlock are shown for recognition. The two secondary connections are exposed for study.
